comment: The rubric for the late-change benchmark. After the second agent has started, the owner changes one decision in ANOTHER agent's session: the keyed limiter must be named KeyedRateLimiter. Nothing on disk says so. The second agent is then told 'Continue.' again. Scoring reads the finished files.

steps.name: the late change is applied: KeyedRateLimiter is exported from a file under src/
the old name is gone: KeyedLimiter is not exported from any file under src/
